rules.editorial_claim_paraphrase_en: The introduction distinguishes full explanatory entries from referral and also-associated entries.
rules.extraction_implication_en: Do not infer that all headings contain full independent articles.

rules.editorial_claim_paraphrase_en: A presents the principal precise meaning and/or general usage of a term, potentially across social-science disciplines.
rules.extraction_implication_en: Capture A as a source-authored exposition section, not automatically a discrete lexical sense.

rules.editorial_claim_paraphrase_en: B presents historical background or a fuller discussion of the general meaning.
rules.extraction_implication_en: Capture B independently from A; do not classify it automatically as an additional sense.

rules.editorial_claim_paraphrase_en: C, D, E and further sections may cover more specialized disciplinary uses, history, controversies, competing interpretations and theoretical questions.
rules.extraction_implication_en: Preserve literal section letters and sequence; no fixed one-letter-to-one-sense mapping.

rules.editorial_claim_paraphrase_en: The source English see is represented in the Persian edition by a left-pointing arrow ← for referral-only entries that send the reader to a fuller main entry.
rules.extraction_implication_en: Keep referral_marker_literal and referral_target_literal; resolve the link only after image-backed target review.

rules.editorial_claim_paraphrase_en: The source English also is rendered as نیز for an alphabetically listed related entry whose full understanding may require another main article.
rules.extraction_implication_en: Keep also separate from see/←; do not treat also as proof of synonymy or an independent full definition.

rules.editorial_claim_paraphrase_en: The original articles were authored by subject specialists and may display their name with the Persian translator after the article.
rules.extraction_implication_en: Record contributor/translator credits separately, only when article boundaries and attribution are visually verified.

rules.editorial_claim_paraphrase_en: The Persian edition involved discipline-specific translators, comparison against English, specialist review and deliberate selection among competing Persian equivalents.
rules.extraction_implication_en: Do not convert editorial decisions or printed equivalents into an automatically approved project glossary; preserve literal print first.

rules.editorial_claim_paraphrase_en: Subsidiary explanations inside paired dashes are described as supplementary or explanatory insertions; sentence structure was adapted in translation.
rules.extraction_implication_en: Preserve the exact paired-dash text, punctuation, and location; annotate commentary separately only after checking the surrounding passage.

rules.editorial_claim_paraphrase_en: The editors generally aimed to transcribe proper names according to pronunciation in the original language, with exceptions.
rules.extraction_implication_en: Do not silently replace or normalize printed proper names; store source literal and any search normalization separately.

rules.editorial_claim_paraphrase_en: The Persian edition states that it follows the orthographic convention of the Maziyar/Farhang-e Andisheh publication series.
rules.extraction_implication_en: Preserve original spelling, spacing and punctuation; editorial modernization requires an explicit separate overlay.

rules.editorial_claim_paraphrase_en: The Persian translators' work was compared with the English source text during the editorial process.
rules.extraction_implication_en: The English text is not in the uploaded Persian scan; do not claim to have verified the correspondence with the original English dictionary.
